note: Army Corps campground at Martis Creek Lake between Truckee and Northstar: one paved, one-way loop under pine above the reservoir, with a few pull-throughs. One RV and one other vehicle per site. Drinking water only at the entrance, in season. --Claude
summary: Alpine Meadow: USACE, May 15 to Oct 15, rec.gov $20, 24 paved sites (38-67 ft), no hookups, vault toilets, water at the entrance. Not waterfront confirmed (nearest sites ~500 m from the water). Pin 125 m from the centroid, fine. Phone empty -> (530) 587-8113.
flags: WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. recreation.gov tags every site 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront', but imagery puts the nearest sites (9-11) ~500 m from the water and 100-250 m from the bare basin below the dam, under pine canopy. That is a catalog boilerplate tag, not a waterfront.
